prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     If object is in reachable range, grab and check it. Then move to location for specific task. If not visible, scan area.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToLocation    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO MoveToLocation
		DO SpecificTask
	END
